wish、would rather、if only 与 it's time: 四种表达"愿望与不满"的虚拟句式:对现在的遗憾、对过去的悔意、对未来的期望。
wish + 过去式:对现在的愿望|wish + had done:对过去的遗憾;wish + would:对将来的期望/抱怨|would rather + 过去式:宁愿别人/别的事怎样|if only 比 wish 更强烈,结构相同|It's (high) time + 过去式:早该做某事了
I wish I knew how to sail.
She wishes she had kept the receipt.
column3: 她真希望当时留了收据。

wish、would rather、if only 与 it's time: I wish the neighbours would stop drilling at dawn.
column3: 真希望邻居别在清晨钻孔。

wish、would rather、if only 与 it's time: I'd rather you didn't mention the budget today.
column3: 我宁愿你今天别提预算。

wish、would rather、if only 与 it's time: It's high time we rewrote this manual.
column3: 我们早该重写这本手册了。

# title: I wish I ___ more about wine.
column4: 对现在的愿望,用过去式 knew。

# title: I wish we ___ the early train yesterday.
column4: 对过去的遗憾,用 had caught。

# title: If only she ___ quieter in the library!
column4: 对现在的愿望,be 用 were。

# title: I'd rather he ___ the news in person.
column4: would rather 接从句时用过去式 told 表现在/将来。

# title: Which wish refers to the past?
wish、would rather、if only 与 it's time: I wish I had taken her advice.|I wish I were braver.|I wish it would stop raining.|I wish dogs could talk.
column4: had taken 表对过去的遗憾。
